# 1. Load Libraries and Data

```{r load}
library(WGCNA)
library(DESeq2)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

# Create output directory if it does not exist
dir.create("08_figures_tables/article_figures", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Load DESeq2 object and VST-transformed expression
dds <- readRDS("06_differential_expression/deseq2_object.rds")
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)

# Load DEG result tables
degs        <- read.csv("06_differential_expression/DEGs_significant.csv")
all_results <- read.csv("06_differential_expression/DESeq2_all_results.csv")

# Load WGCNA results (objects saved in Script 07)
net <- readRDS("07_functional_analysis/WGCNA_net.rds")
load("07_functional_analysis/WGCNA_objects.RData")
```

# 2. DESeq2 Figures

```{r pca, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
# Figure 1A — PCA
pca_plot <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "condition") +
  ggtitle("PCA: Tumor vs Normal") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)

ggsave("08_figures_tables/article_figures/Fig1A_PCA.png",
       pca_plot, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
pca_plot
```

```{r volcano, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
# Figure 1B — Volcano Plot
all_results <- all_results %>%
  mutate(significance = case_when(
    abs(log2FoldChange) > 1 & padj < 0.05 ~ "Significant",
    TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
  ))

volcano <- ggplot(all_results, aes(x    = log2FoldChange,
                                    y    = -log10(padj),
                                    color = significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey70", "#E41A1C")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot: Tumor vs Normal",
       x     = "log2 Fold Change",
       y     = "-log10(adjusted p-value)",
       color = "") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

ggsave("08_figures_tables/article_figures/Fig1B_Volcano.png",
       volcano, width = 8, height = 7, dpi = 300)
volcano
```

```{r heatmap, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# Figure 1C — Heatmap Top 50 DEGs
top50 <- degs %>%
  arrange(padj) %>%
  head(50)

mat        <- assay(vsd)[top50$gene_id, ]
mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(mat)))   # z-score per gene row

col_anno <- data.frame(
  Condition = colData(dds)$condition,
  row.names = colnames(mat)
)

png("08_figures_tables/article_figures/Fig1C_Heatmap.png",
    width = 3000, height = 3000, res = 300)
pheatmap(mat_scaled,
         annotation_col = col_anno,
         show_rownames  = FALSE,
         show_colnames  = TRUE,
         main           = "Top 50 DEGs - Tumor vs Normal",
         fontsize       = 10)
dev.off()

cat("Heatmap saved\n")
```

# 3. WGCNA Figures

```{r wgcna-soft, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
# Figure 2A — Soft Threshold Selection
png("08_figures_tables/article_figures/Fig2A_SoftThreshold.png",
    width = 3000, height = 1500, res = 300)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
powers <- 1:30

plot(sft$fitIndices[,1],
     -sign(sft$fitIndices[,3]) * sft$fitIndices[,2],
     xlab = "Soft Threshold (power)",
     ylab = "Scale Free Topology Model Fit (R²)",
     main = "Scale Independence", type = "n")
text(sft$fitIndices[,1],
     -sign(sft$fitIndices[,3]) * sft$fitIndices[,2],
     labels = powers, col = "red")
abline(h = 0.80, col = "blue")

plot(sft$fitIndices[,1], sft$fitIndices[,5],
     xlab = "Soft Threshold (power)",
     ylab = "Mean Connectivity",
     main = "Mean Connectivity", type = "n")
text(sft$fitIndices[,1], sft$fitIndices[,5],
     labels = powers, col = "red")
dev.off()
cat("Soft threshold figure saved\n")
```

```{r module-trait, fig.width=6, fig.height=8}
# Figure 2B — Module-Trait Heatmap
png("08_figures_tables/article_figures/Fig2B_ModuleTrait.png",
    width = 2000, height = 2500, res = 300)
par(mar = c(6, 8.5, 3, 3))
labeledHeatmap(
  Matrix        = moduleTraitCor,
  xLabels       = "Tumor",
  yLabels       = names(MEs),
  ySymbols      = names(MEs),
  colorLabels   = FALSE,
  colors        = blueWhiteRed(50),
  textMatrix    = textMatrix,
  setStdMargins = FALSE,
  cex.text      = 0.8,
  zlim          = c(-1, 1),
  main          = "Module-Trait Relationships"
)
dev.off()
cat("Module-trait figure saved\n")
```

```{r gs-kme, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
# Figure 2C — GS vs kME Scatter Plots
png("08_figures_tables/article_figures/Fig2C_GS_kME.png",
    width = 4500, height = 1500, res = 300)
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))

verboseScatterplot(kME_blue[net$colors == "blue"],
  GS_tumor[net$colors == "blue"],
  xlab   = "Module Membership - Blue",
  ylab   = "Gene Significance for Tumor",
  main   = "Blue Module", col = "blue", abline = TRUE)

verboseScatterplot(kME_turquoise[net$colors == "turquoise"],
  GS_tumor[net$colors == "turquoise"],
  xlab   = "Module Membership - Turquoise",
  ylab   = "Gene Significance for Tumor",
  main   = "Turquoise Module", col = "turquoise", abline = TRUE)

verboseScatterplot(kME_brown[net$colors == "brown"],
  GS_tumor[net$colors == "brown"],
  xlab   = "Module Membership - Brown",
  ylab   = "Gene Significance for Tumor",
  main   = "Brown Module", col = "brown", abline = TRUE)

dev.off()
cat("GS vs kME figure saved\n")
```

# 4. Functional Enrichment Figures

```{r enrichment-figures}
# Load and export enrichment figures if results exist
if (file.exists("07_functional_analysis/GO_BP_results.rds")) {
  ego_bp <- readRDS("07_functional_analysis/GO_BP_results.rds")

  p_gobp <- dotplot(ego_bp, showCategory = 20) +
    ggtitle("GO Biological Process: Top 20") +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9))

  ggsave("08_figures_tables/article_figures/Fig3A_GO_BP.png",
         p_gobp, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
}

if (file.exists("07_functional_analysis/KEGG_results.rds")) {
  kegg <- readRDS("07_functional_analysis/KEGG_results.rds")

  p_kegg <- dotplot(kegg, showCategory = 20) +
    ggtitle("KEGG Pathways: Top 20") +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9))

  ggsave("08_figures_tables/article_figures/Fig3B_KEGG.png",
         p_kegg, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
}

if (file.exists("07_functional_analysis/GSEA_GO_results.rds")) {
  gsea_go <- readRDS("07_functional_analysis/GSEA_GO_results.rds")

  p_gsea_go <- dotplot(gsea_go, showCategory = 20, split = ".sign") +
    facet_grid(~.sign) +
    ggtitle("GSEA: GO Biological Process")

  ggsave("08_figures_tables/article_figures/Fig3C_GSEA_GO.png",
         p_gsea_go, width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)
}

if (file.exists("07_functional_analysis/GSEA_KEGG_results.rds")) {
  gsea_kegg <- readRDS("07_functional_analysis/GSEA_KEGG_results.rds")

  p_gsea_kegg <- dotplot(gsea_kegg, showCategory = 20, split = ".sign") +
    facet_grid(~.sign) +
    ggtitle("GSEA: KEGG Pathways")

  ggsave("08_figures_tables/article_figures/Fig3D_GSEA_KEGG.png",
         p_gsea_kegg, width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)
}

cat("All enrichment figures saved\n")
```

# 5. Export Summary

```{r summary}
figures <- list.files("08_figures_tables/article_figures/", pattern = ".png")
cat("Total figures exported:", length(figures), "\n\n")
for (f in figures) cat(" -", f, "\n")
```
